I am 68 years old and I have some schooling, enough to read what is written on a seed packet or fertilizer bag. This plot is my own, less than one acre, and last season I grew beans here mixed with maize just like I will do this year. I kept seed from my own harvest because it costs me nothing and I know it grows well here, and I will not buy chemical fertilizer for the beans because the beans fix their own nitrogen and I must save my little cash for other household needs. I will put manure and compost on the plot to keep the soil fertile since I own this land, and I will do all the work myself with my family across the season because the plot is small and I cannot afford to pay workers before the harvest is in.
